props.name: enableBounce
props.description: Rubber-band overscroll bounce at both edges.

props.name: enableRefresh
props.description: Enable the custom rubber-band pull-to-refresh (touch worklets).

props.name: itemKey
props.description: Alternative to `itemKeyField`: a function returning the key.

props.name: itemKeyField
props.description: Field on `T` to use as the unique key per row. Defaults to `'id'`.

props.name: items
props.description: Items to render. Each becomes a `<list-item>` with an `item-key`.

props.name: itemSnap
props.type: boolean | { factor: number; offset: number; } | undefined
props.description:
Snap each item to a rest position after scrolling (native `item-snap`).
`true` = full-screen paging; pass `{ factor, offset }` to customise.
`listType: 'single'` only.

props.name: loadMoreThresholdItemCount
props.description: Number of items from the bottom that triggers `load-more`.

props.name: noMoreData
props.description: No more data to load — stops `loadMore` and shows the end-of-list footer.

props.name: refreshThreshold
props.description: Pull distance (px) past which release triggers a refresh. Default 64.

props.name: upperThresholdItemCount
props.description: Number of items from the top that triggers `scrollToUpper`.

slots.name: item
slots.description: Row template. Receives the item and its current index.

slots.name: refreshHeader
slots.description:
Pull-to-refresh header. `state` is the lifecycle phase; `progress` is the
pull distance as a fraction of the threshold (0..1).

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Rendered in place of the list when `items` is empty.

slots.name: loadMoreFooter
slots.description: Footer shown at the bottom while more data can be loaded.

slots.name: noMoreDataFooter
slots.description: Footer shown at the bottom once `noMoreData` is true.
